name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $59,700 on 28 Nov, 31% below its 52-week high and 21% lower over a month
state: Bitcoin was near $59,700 early on 28 Nov, 31.1% below its 52-week high of about $86,600 and 21% lower over a month (Yahoo Finance). Crypto.news reported on 27 Nov that US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $5.39bn of net outflows in November to 25 Nov and stablecoin market value fell about 12% in 30 days, but no de-peg or top-10 exchange failure was found. The drawdown sits in the 25–45% Watch band.
for_you: Crypto prices are in a deep drawdown and can move sharply. Holders face a higher risk of losses than in normal conditions.

sources.title: crypto.news — Bitcoin price reclaims $61K ahead of $6.8B options expiry

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
